description: A simple baseline model for human pose estimation using plain vision transformers, pre-trained with masked image modeling (e.g., MAE), and achieving state-of-the-art performance on MS COCO Keypoint dataset.

A simple yet effective vision transformer baseline for pose estimation tasks, using a plain and non-hierarchical vision transformer backbone with lightweight decoders. It features structure simplicity, scalability, and flexibility in pre-training data, resolution, and attention type.

Vision transformer-based model for human pose estimation with shift-window and pooling window mechanisms to improve performance and reduce memory footprint. Supports fine-tuning flexibility and transferability via token-based distillation.

A simple yet effective vision transformer baseline for pose estimation, pre-trained on ImageNet-1K, MS COCO, and AI Challenger, and fine-tuned on MS COCO with pose annotations. Achieves SOTA performance on MS COCO test-dev set with 80.9 AP (single model) and 81.1 AP (ensemble of three models).

Simple baseline for vision transformer-based human pose estimation with demonstrated simplicity, scalability, flexibility, and transferability. Achieves best 80.9 AP on MS COCO test-dev set with ViTAE-G backbone.
